figures.alt: Wood fence gate with strap hinges, diagonal bracing, and a latch post
figures.caption: Check the hinge post, rails, grade, and gate frame before adjusting the latch. Sandy soil and moisture can loosen support below the visible hardware.
figures.before: When You Need a Permit in Jacksonville

figures.alt: Black gate strap hinge fastened to a sturdy wood post with exterior screws
figures.caption: The hinge side carries the gate's full weight. Sound fasteners, a stable post, and a properly braced frame matter more than forcing the latch end upward for a quick visual fix.

figures.alt: Runoff directed through a rock-lined swale away from outdoor structures
figures.caption: For a gate near a pool or other safety-sensitive opening, level appearance is not enough. Confirm the post, latch, self-closing behavior, and surrounding drainage together.
